name: amply-app
description: The listening app: reads an artist's manifest, plays it, and pays them.

scripts.build: rm -rf ../.build/app && esbuild src/main.jsx --bundle --splitting --format=esm --target=es2022 --jsx=automatic --jsx-import-source=preact --minify --outdir=../.build/app && node build.mjs && node ../scripts/make-icons.mjs
scripts.test: esbuild test-app.mjs --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --target=es2022 --jsx=automatic --jsx-import-source=preact --outfile=../.build/test/app.js && node ../.build/test/app.js && node test-wallet.mjs && node test-pay.mjs && node test-spend.mjs && node test-paying.mjs && node test-identify.mjs && node test-topup.mjs && node test-player.mjs && node test-collection.mjs && node test-visualizer.mjs && node test-update.mjs && node test-tips.mjs && node test-tags.mjs && node test-library.mjs && node test-security.mjs && esbuild test-fees.mjs --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --target=es2022 --outfile=../.build/test/fees.js --log-level=warning --external:node:sqlite "--banner:js=import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);" && node --no-warnings ../.build/test/fees.js
